caption: Ablation study on delay patterns, weight of the semantic token and Inner Monologue. All models are initialized with Helium, pretrained on audio and use the RQ-Transformer. We vary the weight of the semantic token while keeping the weight of other tokens (including the text token when using Inner Monologue) to 1. As different delay patterns cannot be compared in terms of perplexity, we generate continuations from 3s prompts on the valid set, convert them into transcripts with Whisper and report their negative log-likelihood with LiteLlama-460M-1T[https://huggingface.co/ahxt/LiteLlama-460M-1T] along with their length (in characters) as proxies for linguistic quality.
